Message:
We’re supposed to be
training right now,
so don’t tell me
you were skipping out.”

“Well, I guess it’s fine.
You don’t have to
answer that for now.
It’s not like I have any room
to talk at the moment, anyway...”

“Huh...? ‘I sure have changed’...?
What’s that supposed to mean?

Smiling like that
won’t get you off the hook
for skipping training, you know.
Honestly, you’re always—”

“Getting chewed out
by you like this
sure brings back memories,
doesn’t it?”

“...You’re right.
Back then, everyone was
always so loud,
and totally unserious.
But, we sure had fun...”

“I’ve reunited with you,
Myrlennia, and Guinevere, too.
So once we find everyone again,
we should totally go on
another journey together!”

From how cheerfully
she said those words,
I could tell
she really meant them.

I’m sure that cheerfulness of hers
has already saved me
countless times.

But before, I didn’t understand
how much of a strength
that truly was...
